editorial.blurb: A beloved hole-in-the-wall where exceptional pho and Vietnamese sandwiches earn devoted regulars and rave reviews.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Vietnamese sandwich to go—reviewers were so eager to eat them they literally bit their fingers; pair it with their Vietnamese iced coffee for the full experience.
